# Gallery

The gallery pages collect short, task-oriented examples that sit alongside the main tutorials. They are designed for readers who want to jump straight to a plot type or an analysis pattern without reading a longer narrative page.

## Gallery sections

- [Visualization gallery](visualization-gallery.qmd) — compact examples for scatter, density, joint, and multi-panel plots.
- [Analysis recipes](analysis-recipes.qmd) — short recipes for comparing locations, checking distributions, and working with SPI-style comparisons.

Use these pages as a companion to the main tutorials, especially [Working with survey data](../user-guide/working-with-survey-data.qmd), [Advanced visualization techniques](../user-guide/advanced-visualization-techniques.qmd), and [How to analyse and represent soundscape perception](../user-guide/how-to-analyse-and-represent-soundscapes.qmd).
